name: sample-fallback
title: A deliberate sample 404 selects and names the bundled audible substitute

steps.note: The origin is populated: this is not the old assumption that an empty bucket will provoke fallback.
steps.function: async () => { const response = await fetch('https://pub-6577ff8ba87b4d7e863a12dce1501192.r2.dev/electric-piano/c2.ogg', { method: 'HEAD' }); return { status: response.status, ok: response.ok }; }

steps.note: CDP fulfils the next matching real HEAD request with HTTP 404; the runner fails the following tool step if no request is intercepted.
The fallback belongs to the deliberately failed saxello load and remains audible as the bundled piano.
steps.function: async () => { const key = "{{melody_id}}:vcsl-saxello"; const deadline = Date.now() + 20000; while (Date.now() < deadline) { const notice = window.euter.engine.getSnapshot().fallbacks[key]; if (notice) return notice; await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100)); } return null; }
